item.title: Failed execution attempts are not uncommon in the U.S.
item.description: The failed execution attempt of a woman in Tennessee on Wednesday wasn't the first time this has happened. The state's execution protocols have been under scrutiny for years.
item.content:encoded: The failed execution attempt of a woman in Tennessee on Wednesday wasn't the first time this has happened. The state's execution protocols have been under scrutiny for years.
item.dc:creator: Chiara Eisner

item.title: A witness to a failed Tennessee execution talks about what she saw and heard
item.description: A woman in Tennessee survived an execution Wednesday. We talk with a reporter who was there.
item.content:encoded: A woman in Tennessee survived an execution Wednesday. We talk with a reporter who was there.
item.dc:creator: Catherine Sweeney

item.title: New revelations in Cornell sexual assault case spark outrage
item.description: The alleged victim of a 2024 gang rape at Cornell University clearly said in her police statement that she was sexually assaulted, her attorney told NPR — counter to what a prosecutor has claimed.

item.title: The family of Renee Good files lawsuits over her death during Minneapolis ICE raids
item.description: The fatal shooting of Renee Good by a federal immigration agent last January in Minneapolis set off a firestorm of protests around the U.S. Her family is speaking out for the first time.

item.title: A judge permanently dismisses former Olympian's Reflecting Pool charges
item.description: Citing "exceptional circumstances," a D.C. judge has ruled that the federal government cannot refile its Reflecting Pool charges against David Hearn, despite pressure from President Trump to do so.

item.title: AI data centers: How much are ratepayers on the hook for?
item.description: Data centers consume large amounts of power and require upgrading infrastructure. But it's difficult to determine how much residential customers benefit and how much they actually pay for the benefit.

item.title: Tennessee halts executions after woman survives lethal injection
item.description: Christa Gail Pike was sentenced to death for a 1995 murder and was supposed to be executed Wednesday night. But after two lethal injections, she was still alive.

item.title: New space station crew launches from Florida on SpaceX's Crew Dragon capsule
item.description: The crew of four — two NASA astronauts, one from Canada, and a Russian cosmonaut — heads to the International Space Station after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.
